acceptanceCriteria: The refusal is typed and names the signature and count.
A changed input digest clears it.
A declared remediation clears it once, with an audit record.
body: From GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#1048 (opened 2026-10-17). Feature request; not yet specified. Problem A test or run that failed with the same normalised error is queued again with no relevant change, consuming a scarce resource each time. Current workaround A runner keeps a signature per failing item; after two identical failures it refuses to claim a resource until the ticket notes declare a fix. Proposal A failure-signature ledger in `preflight` and `run-batch`: refuse after N identical signatures at the same input digest unless a remediation reference is declared. See beamfall/corvint#1048 for the full text.
title: preflight/run-batch: refuse re-running an identical failure signature at unchanged inputs (issue #1048)
